title: Wherefore
summary: WHEREFORE, adverb [where and for.] 1. For which reason. WHEREFORE by their fruits ye shall know them. Matthew 7:20. 2. Why; for what reason. WHEREFORE didst thou doubt? Matthew 14:31.
